headline: GOLD SLUMPS BELOW $4,500 — Hot US Jobs Data Cements 42% Chance of December Rate Hike
snippet: Gold fell to near $4,450 on June 3 after US job openings surged in April to their highest level in nearly two years, reinforcing expectations the Fed will hold — or hike — rates; CME FedWatch now prices a 42% probability of a December rate hike, with Friday's Nonfarm Payrolls watched closely for confirmation.

headline: BONANZA-GRADE: Aya Gold Drills 1,867 g/t Silver Over 6 Metres Near Pit Depth at Morocco's Zgounder
snippet: Aya Gold & Silver (TSX: AYA) cut 1,867 g/t Ag over 6.0m in hole ZG-RC-26-946, while underground drilling returned 2,176 g/t over 8.4m at Zgounder Silver Mine in Morocco; CEO Benoit La Salle confirmed strong mineralization continuity as the team completes 30.8% of its 2026 exploration program.

headline: PENTAGON'S 2027 DEADLINE: Trump Accelerates US-China Rare Earth Decoupling in $30 Billion Magnet Market
snippet: A DFARS rule effective January 1, 2027 bans Chinese rare earth magnets from all U.S. defense procurement; with lead times for new mines measured in years and Chinese licensing approvals below 25% in key sectors, Western rare earth developers face a mandated demand cliff that has no easy short-term substitute.

headline: Silver Drops to $73 Despite Sixth Consecutive Annual Supply Deficit — Shortfall Widens to 46 Million Ounces
snippet: Silver pulled back to $73.61 on June 4 as a firming dollar and hawkish Fed expectations weighed on prices, yet the Silver Institute projects a 46.3 million ounce global supply deficit in 2026 — the sixth consecutive shortfall — with structural demand from solar, EVs, and AI data-center infrastructure showing no sign of retreat.

headline: COSALÁ UPGRADE: Americas Gold & Silver Drills 2-3x Resource Grades at Mexican Silver Complex
snippet: Americas Gold and Silver (NYSE: USAS) reported resource-conversion drilling at Cosalá returned silver grades substantially above the currently modeled inferred resource at San Rafael Upper, 120 Upper, and 120 Lower zones, setting up meaningful upside for its upcoming 2026 resource update.

headline: Selkirk Copper Wraps 52,288-Metre Phase 1 at Minto, Yukon — Phase 2 Already 14,000m In with Four Drills Turning
snippet: Selkirk Copper (TSXV: SCMI) completed its Phase 1 drill program at the historic Minto copper-gold-silver project in Yukon with exceptional results across five target areas, including 3.77% Cu, 6.74 g/t Au, and 23.68 g/t Ag over 3.8m; the 50,000m Phase 2 has four rigs active, averaging 120m/day and already 14,000m complete in its first month.

headline: ENERGY RACE: Load Up on Nuclear Before Data Center Power Demand Explodes — Three ETFs Covering the Full Chain
snippet: Meta's 7.8 GW nuclear deal and Microsoft's reactor reactivation agreements — combined with the US government's $2.7B contracts for domestic uranium enrichment and Kazatomprom trimming output by 5% — are locking in a structural bull case for uranium; three ETFs covering reactor operators, miners, and smart-grid infrastructure offer different entry points.

headline: SUPPLY CRISIS: Chile Copper Output Falls 14% in April — Seventh Consecutive Month of Declining Production
snippet: Chile's copper production dropped 14% year-on-year to 399,954 metric tons in April — seven consecutive months of decline at the world's largest producer — as falling ore grades and processing challenges weigh on major operations; the persistent shortfall is widening the gap between mine supply and fast-growing electrification demand.

headline: What Experts Expect for Gold and Silver Prices in June 2026 — $5,000 Gold by Q4, $95–$106 Silver by Year-End
snippet: Goldman Sachs maintains a $5,400 year-end gold target while analysts broadly expect prices to grind toward $5,000 by Q4; silver is forecast to recover to $95–$106 on six consecutive supply deficits, though near-term headwinds include a strong dollar and a growing probability of a Fed rate hike in December following April's hot JOLTS data.

headline: Gold SWOT: China Imported 790+ Tonnes of Silver in Early 2026 — Demand Story Intact Despite Price Pullback
snippet: China's silver imports exceeded 790 tonnes in early 2026, partly driven by record solar panel production after Beijing reclassified silver as a strategic material in January; GoldSeek's weekly SWOT analysis argues the demand narrative for both gold and silver mining equities remains intact even as spot prices consolidate below prior peaks.
